stories.title: Knox Area Transit will be closed on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: KAT said there will be no fixed-route or LIFT service on Nov. 26. Services will operate on a Sunday schedule on Nov. 27.

stories.title: Jefferson City police searching for Carson-Newman student missing since Saturday
stories.summary: The Jefferson City Police Department said Sean Mitchell Simmons, 19, was last seen at the CNU West Campus Commons on Nov. 21 around 5 a.m.

stories.title: Knoxville churches explore partnerships to keep historic buildings open amid financial struggles
stories.summary: Amid a national trend of church closures, some Knoxville area churches are seeking community partners to help keep their doors open.

stories.title: Knox Co. Sheriff's Office lawsuit payouts total $4.58M since 2016
stories.summary: KCSO claim payouts total $4.58M since 2016 Three payments account for more than half the $4.58 million in claims tied to the Knox County Sheriff’s Office since 2016.

stories.title: Union County puts moratorium on data centers and Flock cameras
stories.summary: A Monday night commission meeting resulted in pauses on planning for data centers and Flock cameras in Union County.

stories.title: Union County Farmers Market at Heritage Park says its shutting down after it's most successful season yet
stories.summary: The market blamed county leaders, while critics said the county hired a new manager and planned to take over for the next season.

stories.title: Operations back to normal after bomb threat at Tri-Cities Airport
stories.summary: Officials said two passengers made threatening remarks while aboard an airplane.

stories.title: 'He was the best dad' | 10 Years post-wildfire, some wounds never heal
stories.summary: After the 2016 wildfires devastated Sevier County, the Tinker family still mourns both their patriarch, Eddie Tinker, and the loss of their cherished family home.

stories.title: University of Tennessee fans push back on use of alleged fake crowd sound rumors
stories.summary: Rumors resurface around Neyland Stadium's alleged fake crowd noise during games, but lifelong Vols fans strongly deny the claims.

stories.title: Demolition of historic Masonic Temple underway in downtown Knoxville
stories.summary: Demolition crews dismantle Knoxville's historic Masonic Temple despite failed preservation efforts.

stories.title: Thanksgiving meal distribution continues across East Tennessee ahead of Thursday
stories.summary: Second Harvest Food Bank and Tabernacle Missionary Baptist Church hosted a giveaway Monday morning.

stories.title: Xul Beer Co. expands PB&J Mixtape beer statewide
stories.summary: Xul Beer Co.'s PB&J Mixtape is now being sold across the state of Tennessee, months after the Knoxville-based brewery expanded into Nashville.
